The Problem

Contractors Lose Jobs Not Because They Can't Do the Work — But Because They Can't Track It

A lead calls on Monday. You write their number on a sticky note. Wednesday you're slammed with a job and forget to call back. By Friday they've hired someone else. This happens dozens of times a year at most contractor businesses — not because the contractor is bad, but because there's no system to track where every lead is and what the next step is.

The same problem kills repeat business. A customer you worked with 18 months ago needs their HVAC serviced again — but because there's no record of the relationship, no follow-up was ever triggered, and they found a different contractor through Google. Meanwhile, you're spending money on ads to find new customers when your best source of revenue is sitting untouched in a pile of old invoices.

A CRM built for contractors changes this. Every lead has a card. Every card has a stage. Every stage has a next action. You see at a glance who needs a call, who needs an estimate, who's waiting on a proposal, and who's ready to schedule — without holding any of it in your head. Our platform grows with you, from a simple table and kanban view all the way to a fully managed marketing and automation engine.

What You Get
